mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.kind, o.partner_id, o.order_date, o.delivery_date, o.warehouse_id, o.status, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.tax_amount, o.source, o.flow_instance_id, o.remark, o.version, o.currency, o.exchange_rate, o.dept_id, o.create_by, o.approve_by, o.approve_time, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.contract_id, o.supplier_confirm, o.promised_date, o.confirm_remark, o.confirm_time, o.discount_amount, o.rebate_amount, o.external_no, pc.contract_no, COALESCE(sp.code, cu.code) AS partner_code, COALESCE(sp.name, cu.name) AS partner_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, au.nickname AS approve_by_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.done_qty - i.return_qty), 0) FROM scm_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS done_qty

FROM scm_order o LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON o.kind = 'PURCHASE' AND sp.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer cu ON o.kind = 'SALES' AND cu.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = o.approve_by LEFT JOIN scm_purchase_contract pc ON pc.id = o.contract_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE o.kind = 'PURCHASE' AND o.partner_id = #{supplierId} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') AND o.supplier_confirm IS NULL AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL')
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))))
ORDER BY o.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_order SET status = 'DRAFT', approve_by = NULL, approve_time = NULL, supplier_confirm = NULL, promised_date = NULL, confirm_remark = NULL, confirm_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = #{id} AND i.done_qty > 0)
